description: Implement log retention and hot-warm-cold tiering for a 5TB/day Elasticsearch cluster. Must: classify log types by retention requirement (audit: 7 years, app: 90 days, debug: 7 days), configure ILM policies to tier logs from hot SSD to warm HDD to cold S3, set up deletion schedules, verify retention policies are enforced, and monitor storage usage. Risk factors: ILM policy misconfiguration deleting logs prematurely, hot-to-warm transition causing search performance degradation, S3 cold storage access latency. Tools available: Elasticsearch, Curator, aws CLI, S3, Kibana.
